newsitem.title: UK: SMITH&NEPHEW SEES 4 MLN STG DERMAGRAFT COST.
newsitem.headline: SMITH&NEPHEW SEES 4 MLN STG DERMAGRAFT COST.

text.p: Smith & Nephew said on Tuesday launch costs for its new Dermagraft skin graft product would be four million stg in the second half of the year.
Launch costs for the revolutionary product were two million stg in the first half, the British healthcare group said.
Dermagraft will be launched in the UK in October. It will be introduced in other north European countries later in the year.
The product will be rolled out across the world in 1998, Smith & Newphew chief executive Chris O'Donnell said during a telephone conference.
Dermagraft profits will only start coming through in 1999 to reach "normal" margins by 2000 and 2001, O'Donnell said.
"It gets Smith & Nephew fairly and squarely on the map in the delivery of biological solutions to particularly difficult wound healing problems," he said.
Dermagraft is targeted in particular at diabetics with serious foot ulcers. Some analysts earlier predicted peak sales of 300 million stg by 2003.
